title: Anti-bullying laws and youth risky health behaviors
title_zh: 反欺凌法律与青少年危险健康行为
title_primary: 反欺凌法律与青少年危险健康行为
title_secondary: Anti-bullying laws and youth risky health behaviors
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services has urged a coordinated “public health approach” to combatting bullying in schools, in part due to concerns that bullying victimization causes teens to turn to risky behaviors as a coping mechanism. This study provides new evidence on the effect of anti-bullying laws (ABLs) on youth risky health behaviors. Using data from the Youth Risk Behavior Surveys and a generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find little evidence that ABL adoption leads to statistically significant or economically meaningful reductions in binge drinking, tobacco use, marijuana use, risky sex, or body weight for the average teenager. However, for some historically marginalized youth—particularly those who identify as lesbian, gay, bisexual, or questioning—we find some evidence of ABL-induced improvements in behavioral health, especially with respect to binge drinking. This finding is consistent with disproportionate ABL health gains for queer youth.
abstract_zh: 美国卫生与公众服务部呼吁采取协调一致的“公共卫生方法”来应对校园欺凌问题，部分原因是担心遭受欺凌会导致青少年将高风险行为作为应对机制。本研究为反欺凌法对青少年高风险健康行为的影响提供了新证据。基于青少年风险行为调查数据及广义双重差分法，我们发现几乎没有证据表明反欺凌法的实施会导致普通青少年在暴饮、吸烟、大麻使用、危险性行为或体重方面出现统计显著或经济意义上的显著减少。然而，对于部分历史上处于边缘地位的青少年——尤其是那些自认为女同性恋、男同性恋、双性恋或性取向不确定的青少年——我们发现一些证据表明反欺凌法改善了其行为健康，特别是在暴饮方面。这一发现与反欺凌法对性少数青少年健康收益不成比例的现象一致。

title: Forward-Looking Labor Supply Responses to Changes in Pension Wealth: Evidence from Germany
title_zh: 前瞻性劳动供给对养老金财富变化的反应：来自德国的证据
title_primary: 前瞻性劳动供给对养老金财富变化的反应：来自德国的证据
title_secondary: Forward-Looking Labor Supply Responses to Changes in Pension Wealth: Evidence from Germany
authors: Artmann, Elisabeth, Fuchs-Schündeln, Nicola, Giupponi, Giulia
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We provide new evidence of forward-looking labor supply responses to changes in pension wealth. We exploit a 2014 German reform that increased pension wealth for mothers by an average of 4.4% per child born before January 1, 1992. Using administrative data on the universe of working histories, we implement a difference-in-differences design comparing women who had their first child before versus after January 1, 1992. We document significant reductions in labor earnings, driven by intensive margin responses. Our estimates imply that, on average, an extra euro of pension wealth reduces unconditional labor earnings by 54 cents.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于养老金财富变化对前瞻性劳动供给影响的新证据。利用2014年德国一项改革，该改革使1992年1月1日前生育子女的母亲人均养老金财富增加4.4%。基于涵盖全体工作历史的行政数据，我们采用双重差分法，比较首次生育时间在1992年1月1日前后女性的差异。研究发现劳动收入显著下降，主要源于集约边际调整。估算结果表明，平均每增加1欧元养老金财富，无条件劳动收入将减少54欧分。

title: The Political Consequences of Mass Repatriation
title_zh: 大规模遣返的政治后果
title_primary: 大规模遣返的政治后果
title_secondary: The Political Consequences of Mass Repatriation
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: What happens when a country’s electorate suddenly expands by hundreds of thousands of new voters? This study examines the political impact of the mass arrival of repatriates from Algeria to France. Using this quasi-experiment, I demonstrate that their arrival caused significant changes in the French electoral landscape. In areas of exposure to their arrival, they increased the French electorate and reshaped the vote for right-wing parties. Furthermore, their presence influenced candidates’ electoral strategies, causing all candidates to shift their electoral manifestos towards pro-repatriate stances. This significant historical event influenced French political life, reshaping electoral dynamics and political strategies in France.
abstract_zh: 当一个国家的选民突然增加数十万新选民时，会发生什么？本研究考察了阿尔及利亚归国者大规模抵达法国所产生的政治影响。利用这一准实验，我证明他们的到来导致了法国选举格局的重大变化。在受其抵达影响的地区，他们扩大了法国选民规模，并重塑了右翼政党的选票分布。此外，他们的存在影响了候选人的选举策略，促使所有候选人将选举宣言转向支持归国者的立场。这一重大历史事件影响了法国的政治生活，重塑了法国的选举动态和政治策略。

title: Assessing risks to fiscal policy: Calibrating stochastic debt sustainability analysis models
title_zh: 评估财政政策风险：校准随机债务可持续性分析模型
title_primary: 评估财政政策风险：校准随机债务可持续性分析模型
title_secondary: Assessing risks to fiscal policy: Calibrating stochastic debt sustainability analysis models
authors: Sebastian Barnes & Eddie Casey & Fred Hanmer
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Stochastic debt sustainability analysis (SDSA) is a key tool for assessing risks in modern fiscal policymaking. Yet, designing and calibrating these models poses significant challenges. Using a panel of up to 24 OECD countries with data spanning from 1980, this paper argues that pooling data across countries provides a more representative reflection of fiscal risks, effectively extends sample periods, and a trend-cycle approach better accounts for structural changes. The choice of calibration method is policy relevant as it substantially alters the required primary balance adjustments to stabilise the debt ratio implied by the models. Given that real-time macroeconomic risks are skewed to the downside during economic upswings, the paper proposes a state-contingent (SC-SDSA) approach conditioned on contemporaneous output gap estimates. This suggests that risks are greater during economic booms than conventional approaches and that larger structural primary balances are required than in normal times to ensure adequate fiscal buffers.
abstract_zh: 随机债务可持续性分析（SDSA）是现代财政政策制定中评估风险的关键工具。然而，此类模型的设计与校准面临重大挑战。本文基于24个OECD国家自1980年以来的面板数据，论证了跨国家数据整合能更全面地反映财政风险，有效延长样本周期，且趋势-周期方法能更好地解释结构性变化。校准方法的选择具有政策相关性，因为它会显著改变模型隐含的稳定债务比率所需的基本收支调整幅度。鉴于经济上行期实时宏观经济风险倾向于下行，本文提出一种基于当期产出缺口估计的状态依存（SC-SDSA）方法。这表明经济繁荣期的风险高于传统方法所揭示的水平，且需要比正常时期更大的结构性基本收支盈余，以确保充足的财政缓冲。

title: 数据赋能的两面性：低碳与居民收入增长何以兼得？

abstract: 推动数字化和绿色化协同发展是“十五五”期间实现我国经济高质量发展和“双碳”目标的关键抓手。本文基于数据部门寡头竞争的特征构建了一个多地区多部门一般均衡模型，从全国和区域层面考察了数据价值链中各生产环节的技术进步对碳排放与福利的影响，并对现有低碳政策的效果进行了评估。结果表明：（1）信息数据化和算力的提升显著推动了全行业产出和产业数字化水平增长，进而提高了居民实际收入，且二者协同赋能的福利效应更为显著；（2）这两类数字技术进步也因刺激能源需求而导致碳排放总量上升，侵蚀了居民的净福利。特别地，数据部门的碳排放增长幅度远高于商品部门，表明其正成为不可忽视的碳排放来源；（3）数字技术协同发展虽大幅推动西部地区产业结构跃迁，但也使得区域间收入差距与环境压力同步扩大，导致西部地区净福利受损最为严重；（4）在现行技术条件下，碳税是实现经济增长与低碳转型双赢的有效手段。相比之下，电力补贴虽能提升居民实际收入，却因刺激能源需求而加剧了碳排放；碳捕集与封存技术则同时损害了居民实际收入与净福利。本文通过揭示数字经济时代的“杰文斯悖论”，为数字技术在促进经济增长与可持续发展之间的平衡路径选择提供了政策启示。

title: Are We Doing More Harm than Good? Using Hypothetical Bias Reduction Techniques in Consequential Decision Settings
title_zh: 我们是否弊大于利？在后果性决策情境中使用假设性偏差减少技术
title_primary: 我们是否弊大于利？在后果性决策情境中使用假设性偏差减少技术
title_secondary: Are We Doing More Harm than Good? Using Hypothetical Bias Reduction Techniques in Consequential Decision Settings
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Researchers deploying stated preference surveys to value public goods commonly use techniques designed to reduce bias in hypothetical choice settings. This practice is at odds with evidence that most survey respondents perceive that their decisions are not hypothetical but instead have economic consequences. We examine three bias reduction procedures in both hypothetical and incentive-compatible, real payment settings: cheap talk, solemn oath, and certainty adjustment. We confirm that adjusting hypothetical choices based on response certainty or using a solemn oath can reduce hypothetical bias. In the incentive-compatible decision setting, the oath increases willingness to pay (WTP), and certainty adjustment can lead to serious distortions in demand estimates. Cheap talk does not alter mean WTP but leads to a stark difference in WTP across sexes. To minimize unintended consequences, our results suggest that survey researchers should deploy screening questions to better target these hypothetical bias reduction techniques.

abstract: As public debt in emerging markets (EMs) and low-income countries (LICs) has surged since the COVID-19 pandemic, so has the exposure of domestic banks to their sovereigns—raising concerns of destabilizing feedback loops if fiscal conditions deteriorate. This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of this sovereign-bank nexus using a new granular dataset covering over 120 EMs and LICs, combined with IMF Financial Soundness Indicators. We document a marked post-pandemic strengthening of the nexus, particularly in Sub-Saharan Africa and the Middle East and Central Asia, and show that public debt levels, deposit rates, and nonperforming loans are its most robust correlates. title: The Causal Effect of Debt on Interest Rates
title_zh: 债务对利率的因果效应
title_primary: 债务对利率的因果效应
title_secondary: The Causal Effect of Debt on Interest Rates
authors: Abhik Bhatt, Anthony M. Diercks, Benjamin Eyal, Arsenios Skaperdas
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper uses a natural experiment to measure the causal effect of an expected debt-financed fiscal stimulus on interest rates. We find that a 1 percentage point increase in the expected US debt-to-GDP ratio leads to an increase of about 1-2 basis points in the longer-run neutral rate ( r∗ ) and of about 2–3 basis points in the 10-year Treasury term premium. Our results validate estimates from a common time-series approach that regresses long-term forward interest rates on long-term projections of government debt, where the exclusion restriction does not apply.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一项自然实验，衡量预期债务融资型财政刺激对利率的因果效应。我们发现，美国预期债务与GDP比率每上升1个百分点，长期中性利率（r∗）将上升约1-2个基点，10年期国债期限溢价将上升约2-3个基点。我们的结果验证了一种常见时间序列方法的估计值，该方法将长期远期利率对政府债务的长期预测进行回归，而排他性约束在此并不适用。

title: Impact of geopolitical risk on global financial market connectedness: evidence from dynamic analysis based on multilayer nonlinear network
title_zh: 地缘政治风险对全球金融市场关联性的影响：基于多层非线性网络动态分析的证据
title_primary: 地缘政治风险对全球金融市场关联性的影响：基于多层非线性网络动态分析的证据
title_secondary: Impact of geopolitical risk on global financial market connectedness: evidence from dynamic analysis based on multilayer nonlinear network
authors: Jiaxin He, Shaofang Li, Tingting Ren
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We use the monthly data of geopolitical risk (GPR) and financial markets, including stock, bond, and exchange rate markets in 23 countries between January 2013 and June 2023, and employ a multilayer nonlinear network to accurately capture and analyse the complex, interrelated dynamics between geopolitical risks and financial markets. The results indicate that geopolitical risk events alter the pattern of financial risk connectedness. During periods of geopolitical stress, GPR becomes the primary risk transmitter, displacing the stock market as the dominant source of risk spillovers. Although GPR is normally more closely associated with the stock market, during major geopolitical events its influence shifts towards the bond market with a noticeable lag. Major economies and geopolitical focal countries serve as key risk spillovers, while other emerging economies primarily act as risk recipients.

title: What Determines State Heterogeneity in Response to U.S. Tariff Changes?
title_zh: 美国关税变化下各州异质性反应的决定因素是什么？
title_primary: 美国关税变化下各州异质性反应的决定因素是什么？
title_secondary: What Determines State Heterogeneity in Response to U.S. Tariff Changes?
authors: Ana Maria Santacreu, Michael Sposi, Jing Zhang
abstract: We develop a structural framework to identify the sources of cross‐state heterogeneity in response to U.S. tariff changes. A unilateral 25‐percentage‐point U.S. tariff increase across sectors induces consumption changes ranging from −0.8% in Oregon to 2.3% in Montana. This variation stems from the interaction between states' internal comparative advantage and the nation's external comparative advantage. Factor mobility lowers aggregate consumption and reshapes the cross‐state impacts by shifting resources toward more distorted states and sectors. Consequently, preferred tariff changes vary systematically across states, necessitating transfers to align regional policy incentives. Foreign retaliation reduces aggregate gains while perpetuating cross‐state variation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个结构性框架，用以识别美国关税变化中各州异质性反应的来源。若美国对各行业统一加征25个百分点的关税，各州消费变化幅度从俄勒冈州的-0.8%到蒙大拿州的2.3%不等。这种差异源于各州内部比较优势与国家外部比较优势之间的相互作用。要素流动性通过将资源向扭曲程度更高的州和行业转移，降低了总体消费水平并重塑了跨州影响。因此，各州偏好的关税变化呈现系统性差异，需要通过转移支付来协调区域政策激励。外国报复性措施在减少总体收益的同时，进一步加剧了跨州差异。

title: Living Up to Expectations: The Effectiveness of Forward Guidance and Inflation Dynamics Post-Global Financial Crisis
title_zh: 符合预期：全球金融危机后前瞻性指引的有效性与通胀动态
title_primary: 符合预期：全球金融危机后前瞻性指引的有效性与通胀动态
title_secondary: Living Up to Expectations: The Effectiveness of Forward Guidance and Inflation Dynamics Post-Global Financial Crisis
authors: Stephen J. Cole, Enrique Martínez García, Eric Sims
official: 官方在线 August 202 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the effectiveness of forward guidance when central banks face private agents with heterogeneous expectations allowing for a degree of bounded rationality. Exploiting unique survey-based measures of expected inflation, output growth, and interest rates, we estimate a small-scale New Keynesian model with forward guidance shocks for the United States and the other G7 countries plus Spain. We find that the share of fully-informed rational expectations (FIRE) agents in aggregate expectations is similar for the U.S., the U.K., Germany, and other major advanced economies (albeit far from one); however, Japan’s share is much lower. For each country, the estimate of the share of FIRE agents has declined over time as VAR-based expectations — the heuristic approach assumed under bounded rationality — became more prominent in explaining the more recent data. Forward guidance has correspondingly grown less effective. In a counterfactual analysis, we document that, in the wake of the global financial crisis, inflation would have been significantly higher and the zero lower bound on short-term interest rates much less of a constraint had the public fully incorporated central banks’ forward guidance statements as FIRE agents do. Moreover, in most cases, inflation would have declined more, and somewhat faster, in the wake of the post-COVID-19 inflation surge.

authors: Jack (Peiyao) Ma, Andrea Mantovani, Carlo Reggiani, Annette Broocks, Néstor Duch-Brown
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Dominant platforms like Booking.com have often imposed Price Parity Clauses to prevent lower prices on alternative sales channels. We provide quasi-experimental evidence on the removal of these price restrictions in France in 2015 for three major global hotel groups. Our analysis reveals limited and non-significant price effects for rooms sold through consumer-visible channels, such as hotels’ websites or online travel agencies. However, we document a significant price reduction on sales channels not visible to consumers, such as direct offline bookings. Additionally, we identify a significant shift in the share of bookings from online travel agencies to the hotels’ direct offline channels.
abstract_zh: 像Booking.com这样的主导平台经常实施价格一致性条款，以防止替代销售渠道出现更低价格。我们针对2015年法国三大全球酒店集团取消这些价格限制的情况，提供了准实验证据。分析显示，对于通过消费者可见渠道（如酒店官网或在线旅行社）销售的客房，价格影响有限且不显著。然而，我们发现，在消费者不可见的销售渠道（如直接线下预订）上，价格显著下降。此外，我们还发现预订份额从在线旅行社显著转向酒店的直接线下渠道。

title: Income taxes and redistribution in the early twentieth century
title_secondary: Income taxes and redistribution in the early twentieth century
abstract: This paper examines the distributive effects of personal income taxation in Sweden, the United Kingdom, and the United States during the first half of the twentieth century. We estimate the evolution of marginal and average effective tax rates across the income distribution and calculate the corresponding indices of progressivity and redistribution. Our results show that redistribution through income taxation increased during the period with varying intensity and mechanisms. During the First World War, this was a joint effect of increases in the amount of revenue collected and progressivity. In contrast, during the Second World War, revenue increased again, but progressivity diminished.

title: A Cost-Benefit Approach to Optimizing Security Precaution Adoption
title_zh: 优化安全预防措施采纳的成本效益方法
title_primary: 优化安全预防措施采纳的成本效益方法
title_secondary: A Cost-Benefit Approach to Optimizing Security Precaution Adoption
authors: Noa Barnir, Neil Gandal, Tyler Moore, Vincent Scott
official: 官方在线 2026-02-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: All U.S defense contractors were required to have fully implemented the 110 security requirements included in NIST Special Publication 800-171 entitled “Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations” by 1 January 2018 whenever a system owned, or operated by or for, a contractor processes, stores, or transmits controlled unclassified information (CUI). Despite the mandate, adoption has been minimal, mostly because the requirement is so costly and time-consuming that medium and small firms cannot afford to comply. Since the adoption of security precautions is costly and time-consuming, in this paper, we propose a constrained optimization methodology to examine this issue.
abstract_zh: 所有美国国防承包商均须在2018年1月1日前全面实施NIST特别出版物800-171《非联邦系统与组织中受控非机密信息的保护》中规定的110项安全要求，只要承包商拥有或运营的系统处理、存储或传输受控非机密信息（CUI）。尽管有强制要求，但采纳程度极低，主要原因在于该要求成本高昂且耗时巨大，中小型企业无力承担。由于安全防护措施的采纳既昂贵又耗时，本文提出一种约束优化方法来研究这一问题。

title: The art of not being chocked: Environmental awareness, residents' responses and land transactions in China
title_zh: 不被窒息的艺术：环境意识、居民响应与中国土地交易
title_primary: 不被窒息的艺术：环境意识、居民响应与中国土地交易
title_secondary: The art of not being chocked: Environmental awareness, residents' responses and land transactions in China
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of environmental awareness on land transactions. We leverage the exogenous shock caused by the unexpected release of the environmental documentary Under the Dome in early 2015 in China, and use the birthplace of the interviewees in filmmaker's previous signature program as the instrument for exposure. We observe that the cities with more exposure to the documentary exhibit significant reduction in land transaction activities. Mechanism analysis indicates that after the release of documentary, residents awareness of air pollution increases substantially, accompanied by a notable rise in migration intention. This indicates the real impacts of environmental perception on household behavior and land transactions.
